introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.p1: Welcome to SentientArchive. These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your access to and use of the SentientArchive AI-Powered Knowledge OS (the "Service"). By accessing or using our Service, you agree to be bound by these Terms and our Privacy Policy.
introduction.p2: SentientArchive is designed to be your cognitive partner, organizing information through advanced neural processing. Our mission is to ensure that your personal knowledge remains secure, private, and eternally accessible.

dataCollection.title: 2. Data Collection
dataCollection.intro: To provide the SentientArchive experience, we collect specific information regarding your interactions with the OS. This includes:

semanticInput.label: Semantic Input:
semanticInput.description: Text, documents, and files you upload to your private archive.

metadata.label: Metadata:
metadata.description: Technical information about how the AI processes your queries for optimization.

deviceIdentity.label: Device Identity:
deviceIdentity.description: Minimal identifiers required for secure multi-device synchronization.

dataCollection.quote: "We do not sell your personal archive data to third parties. Your knowledge is yours alone."

userObligations.title: 3. User Obligations
userObligations.p1: As a user of SentientArchive, you agree to maintain the security of your encryption keys and account credentials. You are responsible for all activity that occurs under your unique identifier.
userObligations.p2: You agree not to use SentientArchive to store:

items.illegal: Illegal content or materials that violate international law.
items.malicious: Malicious code, viruses, or disruptive AI agents.
items.ip: Content that infringes upon the intellectual property of others.

termination.title: 4. Termination
termination.p1: You may terminate your SentientArchive account at any time. Upon termination, you will have a 30-day window to export your data in a portable JSON-LD format. After this period, all encrypted data will be permanently purged from our distributed nodes.
